title: How competition between Brazilian delivery app iFood and Meituan's Keeta in Brazil has descended into accusations of corporate espionage and shady tactics (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: How competition between Brazilian delivery app iFood and Meituan's Keeta in Brazil has descended into accusations of corporate espionage and shady tactics — Local courier group iFood and China-backed Keeta trade claims of corporate espionage and underhand tactics — Michael Pooler and Beatriz Langella in São Paulo
